DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0046 2026-08-19
MEETING NOTES — Review of the Duplicate-Note Trial
Tabs
Date: 2026-08-19
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0023 for TEAM-0005; originating desk
liaison; program filing clerk; queue chair.
Purpose: Review the keeper and origin tabs trialled by
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA from 2026-05-25 through 2026-06-12.
ISSUE-0142 and TASK-0376 locate the hydraulics layout example.
Decisions Retain the tab names. The keeper section holds the
reason for selecting the continuing entry, and the origin
section preserves the received questions. Both issue
references belong on the cover sheet. A merge note that states
only similar subject does not explain why the desks considered
the scope equivalent.
The chair will ask for the participating roles, decision date,
and destination of any remaining administrative action. A
disagreement between source desks stays attached to the note
with the chair's resolution. Filing convenience must not erase
the distinction between the questions that prompted the
comparison.
copy to deck lead
The program filing clerk will carry these requirements into a
draft standard for the later policy edition. The example
folder is a layout reference and does not assert a duplicate
relationship for its linked issue.
Action items
_ Owner: PERSON-0023. Due: 2026-08-20. Annotate the layout
with the keeper-selection reason.
— Owner: Originating desk liaison. Due: 2026-08-21. Check that
